trigger.trusted_source: fixture/team signed provider delivery; actual envelope/signature adapter not supplied
trigger.delivery_id: transport receipt only; not the intent key

owner: configured repository automation owner; real identity unresolved
permitted_effect: add needs-triage label to the original fixture issue only
permissions: issues label write restricted to configured repository

claim.duplicate_behavior: return persisted claimed/unknown/succeeded state without resending

recovery.after_claim: stop; no automatic stale takeover without proof owner is dead and effect absent
recovery.after_possible_effect_timeout: state unknown; provider readback by stable key before any retry
recovery.retries: one effect attempt in preview; bounded manual recovery only
recovery.retention: production owner must choose a duration exceeding provider replay and recovery windows before activation

activation_requirements: real provider event/schema and signature verification
repository ownership and least privilege credentials
provider idempotency or authoritative result lookup for unknown outcomes
durable storage backup/retention and transaction semantics validation
